stages.blocked_reason: The bounded matched-STRIDE diagnostic rejects Sniper's generic simple prefetcher; calibrate a traffic-bounded configuration before launching the headline matrix.
stages.name: 40_sniper_streamshield_realgraph
31_gem5_record_width_4b
stages.notes: Compact 4-byte two-stamp record: it SUBSTITUTES for the CSR edge. gem5 now has a real 4-byte two-stamp path (buildInEdgeEpochPairRecords32), so this contrast is no longer vacuous. Reports execution time, dram_offchip_bytes and dram_bus_util_pct together. PRE-REGISTERED: if DRAM bus utilisation is low, the reduction in exposed demand misses should appear as speedup at BOTH widths; if high, the 8-byte arm should lose in proportion to its traffic. SCOPE: gem5 PR only -- bfs/cc/bc/sssp have no compact path and declare 8 bytes. StreamShield variants are EXCLUDED because the stream-load instruction is 8-byte only, so a compact StreamShield arm would change width AND allocation together. ECG_EXPECT_BYTES_PER_EDGE makes the guest abort before the ROI if it is not streaming the width this arm claims.

stages.name: 31_gem5_record_width_8b
stages.notes: Matched 8-byte arm: identical in every respect except the record is forced wide, so the width effect is isolated. gem5 now has a real 4-byte two-stamp path (buildInEdgeEpochPairRecords32), so this contrast is no longer vacuous. Reports execution time, dram_offchip_bytes and dram_bus_util_pct together. PRE-REGISTERED: if DRAM bus utilisation is low, the reduction in exposed demand misses should appear as speedup at BOTH widths; if high, the 8-byte arm should lose in proportion to its traffic. SCOPE: gem5 PR only -- bfs/cc/bc/sssp have no compact path and declare 8 bytes. StreamShield variants are EXCLUDED because the stream-load instruction is 8-byte only, so a compact StreamShield arm would change width AND allocation together. ECG_EXPECT_BYTES_PER_EDGE makes the guest abort before the ROI if it is not streaming the width this arm claims.

stages.name: 40_isa_fused_4b
stages.notes: Fused K2-I delivery, compact 4-byte record. Includes ECG:K2_LRU so the replacement rule and the transport can be separated within the run. Every stage carries its OWN LRU cell so no ratio needs a denominator from another run: two nominally identical LRU cells were measured 1.74% apart in time purely because the guest's property arrays landed one page apart, which is the noise floor for cross-run ratios. Enforcement is live here (ECG_EXPECT_BYTES_PER_EDGE reaches the guest and aborts pre-ROI), unlike the earlier width matrix.

stages.name: 50_fused_compact_4b
stages.notes: Serialized single-core TimingSimple compact K2-I arm; exact request binding is proven separately by the O3 mechanism probe. Runtime activation is attested by ECG_K2_ILOAD_C; the runner fails if the guest does not emit it. Every stage carries its own LRU and K2-LRU, and all stages use one build.

stages.name: 51_fused_software_4b
stages.notes: Matched serialized TimingSimple compact arm using the existing 64-bit fused K2-I load after guest software widening. Decode control for stage 50.

stages.name: 52_fused_wide_8b
stages.notes: Matched serialized TimingSimple wide K2-I arm. Implementation-width control for stage 50; every stage carries its own LRU and K2-LRU and all stages use one build.

stages.name: 60_gem5_proposal_k2m_o3
stages.notes: Mechanism-only proposal gate with a width-unmatched 8-byte non-StreamShield K2 semantic anchor plus transport-matched 4-byte StreamShield lru_only and epoch_first arms. roi_matrix forces capped 2048-event request/bypass traces; every StreamShield row must attest only 4-byte request-flag record loads, exact same-line O3 K2-M Request acceptance, and multiple nonzero record-derived epoch pairs. All three rows must match PageRank semantics. The anchor is not a StreamShield control, and this proves existence and binding rather than request-count or performance coverage.
